about: Tag-Team Talk topics per level: one team at the front, speakers take turns on one topic (relay). Times in seconds. Every topic has 3 hints (ideas), shown when the teacher taps Hints. M.2 is the original set; the Just a Second topics moved here when that game was removed; the rest were written for Kru. crazy = the "Crazy topics only" list (⋯ menu), also with 3 hints. Huddle 1 minute, 20 s per speaker (the teacher can change it in 5 s steps). No bonus cards. Spin picks a random topic, no repeats until all are used. The FOR vs AGAINST version is its own game: tag-team-debate.

intro.title: Tag-Team Talk
text: One team comes to the front.
Speakers take turns talking about one topic.

intro.title: Pick a team, get hints
text: 🎯 Pick a team spins to choose the team at the front.
Stuck? The teacher can show 3 hints for the topic.

intro.title: Huddle first
text: Plan with your team for 1 minute.
Who says what? Who starts? Who finishes?

intro.title: TAG!
text: At the chime, the next speaker continues.
Keep the same topic going!

intro.title: Challenge!
text: The audience can challenge for:
5 seconds of silence, repeating an idea, off topic or Thai.
